comparison.objective: Release a cordless-drill battery and place it in a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize the drill while simultaneously squeezing two opposed buttons and sliding the battery along its rails.
comparison.success_condition: Both buttons actuated together, pack fully removed and released flat in the tray, drill remains near its start, and nothing falls.
comparison.reason: This tests simultaneous dual-button release plus linear pack extraction, not fine-tool locking or iterative damping adjustment.
